notes.title: Adaptive throttling
notes.content:
Throttling now is adjusting to the score as you play. The more you push it the more the game hardens, in reali time. This simplifies configuration and makes the playthroughs more enjoyable and challenging. 
A badly needed retro backdrop was also added. And more is coming...

notes.title: Full SteamVR support
notes.content: All SteamVR compatible headsets should work with the game now. If you experience any difficulties with a particular headset please pm. You can also tilt the controller via the launch options, check the tips discussion on the hub
